purpose: Acquisition plan only. These entries do not register searchable sources or establish legal requirements.
localStatus: The existing 2025 NYC integrated energy publication and NYC electrical amendments are now registered and searchable. Base NEC, historical specialty editions and external technical references remain missing.
admissionRequirements: Fetch the authoritative complete source; preserve its URL, retrieval date, edition, effective date, content hash and published section identifiers.
Retain tables with headings, row labels, footnotes, exceptions, definitions and cross-references. Check extracted text against the original pages.
Keep base standards and local amendments separately attributable; resolve additions, deletions and substitutions before describing consolidated requirements.
Register current and historical editions separately. Select applicability from filing/completeness/transition facts rather than the current date alone.
Do not promote an amendment-only PDF, browser search excerpt or guidance page into a complete enacted-code corpus. Confirm lawful source access for incorporated standards.

sources.limitation: The 67-page city PDF contains amendments; unchanged NEC requirements are still needed. Full effect does not decide an earlier filing's edition.

components: Earlier editions and applicable transition rules when requested
2025 NYC ASHRAE 90.1 and its incorporated base standard
Applicable energy inspection rules and forms
sources.editionSelection: New completed filings on/after March 30, 2026 use 2025; complete filings on/before March 29 may remain under 2020. Check incomplete filings and material changes against the transition notice.
sources.limitation: Residential/commercial scope, filing transitions and historic-report exceptions require applicability facts. Existing tables are extracted as plain text and only unambiguous row/column/footnote associations support numerical conclusions.

components: 2010/2011 transition rules, TR8 and contemporaneous inspection/agency rules
sources.limitation: ECC-09 expressly asks about NYC 2016; ECC-10 supplies a 2010 filing and 2011 approval. A current-code answer cannot resolve those historical questions.

questionTargets.needed: Separate GFCI protection from branch-circuit requirements; acquire base NEC and edition-specific city changes.
Establish downstream protection and the applicable kitchen rule. Button absence alone does not prove protection or its absence; technical testing advice needs its own source.
Device/box grounding, continuity and exceptions for the actual wiring arrangement.
Occupant access to overcurrent devices and exceptions. An ADU-only building-code provision does not establish the rule for an ordinary apartment.
NM cable uses, height/occupancy/concealment conditions and remaining base-standard limits.
Exact room list, branch/receptacle requirements and central-air exception. Do not replace the room list with a window test.
Distinguish AFCI from GFCI scope and preserve the city multifamily equipment exception versus convenience outlets.
Service/load calculation and existing-demand conditions. Spare breaker spaces do not establish electrical capacity.
Percentage limits and calculation basis are separate questions. FC electrical-safety language does not establish use of 120 versus 208 volts.
Separate city height restriction and concealment exception from cable listing. Do not substitute apartment count for floors above grade.
Repair versus alteration, opening work and the actual historic-building exception/report in the governing edition.
Recover versus replacement, exposed cavity/sheathing and insulation exceptions. Roof age and contractor opinions do not decide the rule.
Assembly-specific ceiling performance and permitted alternatives, rather than a claim that one product is mandatory.
Mass-wall and cavity conditions, continuity and the proposed assembly. A gap dimension alone does not establish a compliant detail.
Energy and landmarks requirements separately; historical photographs and nonoriginal windows do not establish an energy exemption.
Separate opaque-door criteria from glazing/SHGC criteria and verify the old schedule's units and applicable edition.
Frame and edge thermal bridging, glazing and actual assembly data. Insulation inside tubing is not evidence of compliant whole-assembly performance.
Room loads, distribution and duct compatibility; code evidence alone cannot size the proposed equipment from this description.
Historical code path, software/version error and conditioned-space boundaries. Do not silently switch to the 2025 standard.
Filing/completeness and inspection obligations versus inspector qualifications and private contract price. Approval date alone does not settle the governing edition.

targetStatus: Section numbers are acquisition leads, not complete verified determinations. Reconcile each with the governing edition, base text and city amendments before registration.
executionLimit: Reused 14 existing byte-hashed official-publication imports; all 362 prepared records bind to those recorded source URLs and hashes. PDFs were not re-downloaded in this environment. Direct NYC downloads are denied by execution-network policy. The official 2020 NFPA free reader returns a JavaScript shell to the available web tool, so no complete base NEC or historical corpus was acquired.
scope: Acquisition and coverage record; actual registration is in research-corpus-registry.mjs. Sources do not establish project applicability.
